transfer.rationale: ST1 R4b checkpoint (frozen from the current-base scratch dry run at d71a1a87 before the move; reported to the operator at the R4a validation stop and approved in chat). App-to-hook transfer of 443 range lines (410 non-blank) for the Jira projects, source board, issue types and field-catalog cluster, in three exports of one file to preserve effect order: a state layer called at the old state position, a search-effects layer at the original position of the two search debounce effects, and a catalog-effects layer at the original position of the first index-clamp effect; each moved effect crosses zero unmoved effects. The two loadConfig seed groups become two inline seam calls at their exact original positions (projects+board, then issue types, with the capacity and priority-weights seeds still between them). The render-time snapshot assignment stays in App with its 10 keys and reads one returned draftSnapshot object. The combined App-plus-owner total grows only by the 247-line scaffolding allowance (160 hook scaffolding + 111 App scaffolding - 11 orphaned import lines - 13 dropped blank separators); the large allowance comes from the 68-name return and its App destructure. dashboard.jsx lineCeiling 14412 is carried (measured 13997; R5 ratchets the manifest and tests/test_codebase_structure_budgets.py). The combined ceiling is measured-plus-allowance.
